description: Câmara Municipal de Águeda : wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Câmara Municipal de Águeda . Coverage: Câmara Municipal de Águeda . The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Áreas Ardidas; PDM 2024 - Planta de Condicionantes – Rede de Defesa da Floresta Contr; PDM 2024 - Planta de Condicionantes – Perigosidade de Incêndio Florest. Formats seen: GPKG, GEOJSON, WMS, DXF, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
